title: Structs
description: struct layout, typedef, and grouped fields

exercises.title: Define a Struct
exercises.description: Define a Person struct with Name (string) and Age (int). Create a Person with Name="Alice" and Age=30. Print it.

exercises.title: Pointer to Struct
exercises.description: Define a Point struct with X and Y (int). Create a pointer to Point{X: 5, Y: 10}. Use the pointer to change Y to 20. Print the Point.

exercises.title: Struct Literal
exercises.description: Given a Book struct with Title, Author, and Pages (int), create a Book instance using just Title and Author. Print it.
hints: `struct Book { char title[32]; char author[16]; int pages; };`
Initialize as `{"Go Programming", "", 0}` to get `{Go Programming  0}` spacing in the reference.

exercises.title: Embedded Struct
exercises.description: Define Person with Name string, and Employee embedded Person with Company string. Create Employee with Name="Bob" and Company="Acme". Print Company.
hints: `struct Employee { struct Person person; const char *company; };`

exercises.title: Zero Value Struct
exercises.description: Declare a variable of type Rectangle with Width and Height (double) without initialization. Print it to see zero values.

exercises.title: Struct Comparison
exercises.description: Define a Config struct with Host (string) and Port (int). Create two Config values with identical fields and compare them using ==. Print the result.

exercises.title: Modify Struct Field
exercises.description: Define a Counter struct with Value int (starts at 0). Create counter, increment Value by 5. Print the Value.
